segments.normalizedSource: ```swift struct StepperView: View { @State private var value = 0 let colors: [Color] = [.orange, .red, .gray, .blue, .green, .purple, .pink] func incrementStep() { value += 1 if value >= colors.count { value = 0 } } func decrementStep() { value -= 1 if value < 0 { value = colors.count - 1 } } var body: some View { Stepper { Text("Value: \(value) Color: \(colors[value].description)") } onIncrement: { incrementStep() } onDecrement: { decrementStep() } .padding(5) .background(colors[value]) } ```
